title: Moroccan Chicken Rfissa
description: A hearty, flavorful Moroccan dish made with roasted chicken, rfissa, and spices.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is roasting, cook the rfissa in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring frequently, until lightly browned.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet with the rfissa and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
To serve, place the roasted chicken on top of the rfissa mixture and garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
